messages:
matt: Quick heads-up — planning a vendor deps + lockfile bump for the rc cutover tomorrow. Targeting to merge the vendor PR and update lockfiles at ~15:00 UTC. Cutoff for other dep/submodule changes = 17:00 UTC. Please avoid large dep churn after cutoff.

anika: Ack. I have a small infra submodule PR (infra/bert) WIP — aiming to finish today. If it slips I can cherry-pick into your vendor bump PR.

kevin: FYI if you're rebasing, remember to run:
```bash
git submodule update --init --recursive
./scripts/vendor-sync.sh
make build
```
I hit a go.mod merge conflict yesterday that was easier to debug after the above.

matt: Good call. Also for anyone with local uncommitted stuff: `git stash push -m "pre-lockfile-bump" --include-untracked` before rebasing. After the vendor PR merges I'll run a staging smoke test and report back.

sara: Heads-up: CI showed flaky integration tests for vets-service after the grpc bump in my branch. If we bump grpc in the vendor PR we should pin to `github.com/grpc v1.21.2` and add a short retry in the test harness. I'll open a follow-up PR if needed.

anika: @sara can you add a short changelog note and rollback steps in the PR description?

sara: Will do. Suggested rollback snippet:
```bash
# revert go.mod change
git checkout HEAD~1 -- go.mod go.sum
# undo deployment
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/vets-service
```
I'll add that to the PR body under "Rollback".

deploy-bot: buildkite: vendor-lock-bump-1923456789 queued (job 4343)

ryan: Small request: try not to touch `yarn.lock` and `package.json` in the same PR as the vendor bump. Keeps frontend installs deterministic. CI should use `yarn install --frozen-lockfile`.

matt: Plan for tomorrow: merge vendor PR ~15:00 UTC, let CI run, run full staging smoke (build + a few end-to-end flows), then tag rc if clean. If anything blocks, raise here asap. If you need an exception to the cutoff, ping me directly. :thumbsup:

kevin: If you see go.mod conflicts, do `git mergetool` + `go mod tidy && git add go.sum go.mod` before committing. That avoided one CI failure for me.

anika: Noted. I'll try to finish infra/bert early and ping once merged.

sara: I'll add the changelog & rollback and put a note on the PR about the flaky test so CI owners can watch.

matt: Thanks all — will post final merge time ~1h before.
